title: Test helper whitelist_check missing to_ipv4_mapped vs to_ipv4 rationale comment
description: config.rs test helper whitelist_check (around line 800): uses to_ipv4_mapped() but only has the RFC reference comment. The production code in session.rs lines 177-178 has the full explanation of WHY to_ipv4_mapped() is used instead of to_ipv4() (the latter also matches deprecated IPv4-compatible addresses). A developer reading only the test helper would not have that context and might simplify it to to_ipv4() in a future refactor, introducing a bug. Fix: add the same explanatory note to the test helper.
